My initial attempts to deploy a MiniCluster failed due to 'Insufficient cpu' errors, suggesting a heavily utilized cluster. A subsequent attempt to use a separate Kubernetes Job to run the benchmark failed because it could not connect to the Flux broker's socket inside the MiniCluster. While debugging with a simple pod, I discovered a critical Python CFFI `ModuleNotFoundError` in the recommended `ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky` image, indicating the image was not functional for this purpose. I then switched to an Ubuntu-based image (`ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-ubuntu:arm-jammy`), but continued to face issues where the pods could not be found after creation, preventing log retrieval. After numerous failed attempts with different configurations and images, I've concluded that the combination of a resource-constrained environment and problematic container images makes it impossible to achieve the goal.
